svg.title: repair04 sample006: bounded repair before and after
svg.desc: Actual first production-selected 10 by 10 millimeter region from the SRJ33 sample006 post-repair03 checkpoint. Regional DRC issues decrease from two to zero. The 0.5 millimeter boundary collar and all 41 locked route points stay unchanged. Copper widths and via diameters are to scale. Top and bottom layers are superimposed; fixed obstacle footprints use the local SRJ geometry. This figure is a local repair demonstration, not a dataset benchmark.

g.text: 10 × 10 mm repair bounds · 0.5 mm fixed collar · all 41 locked route points unchanged
Solid outline: repair bounds. Dashed outline: movable interior. Outside context is fixed.
Copper widths and via diameters are to scale; layers are superimposed. Square markers are annotations.
Actual first production-selected region · core a284c44 · SRJ33 f566b62 · regional DRC + fixed-obstacle guard
Merge accepted by Pipeline9. Regional counts shown here are a local repair demonstration, not a new dataset benchmark.
